frame.text:
This is a lot. We will need to figure out how to progressively add and remove complexity, focus the user on a single task in depth, or multiple tasks at a high level, progressive disclosure to human and agent, etc. But your task was to pressure test the system and I think you have accomplished it.

One affordance to explore: the agent needs to be able to direct the user’s attention. Perhaps when a canvas is open but the agent needs the user’s attention in chat, the canvas could flip grayscale or something to make the relative attention focus obvious.

you.text: I like your rec — please document the decision with your rationale. We will likely adopt a design system later with corporate guidelines, so the specific color you choose will likely be superseded. I like your rec, we just need to be able to keep the spirit of it in the future if the actual color is superseded.
